description: This file provides functions for encoding and decoding variable-length integers (varints) in Rust, including tests. It contains external function declarations, inline safety comments, and defines two primary functions: `decode_varint` and `encode_varint`, along with a test module.

methods.name: decode_varint(bufp: *mut *const u8) -> u64
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length integer from a pointer to a buffer, returning 0 on overflow or if the integer exceeds u64::MAX.

methods.name: encode_varint(value: u64, buf: *mut u8) -> u8
methods.description: Encodes a `u64` value into a buffer as a variable-length integer, returning the number of bytes written or the size needed if buffer is null.

ctags.name: decode_varint
ctags.pattern: /^pub unsafe extern "C" fn decode_varint(bufp: *mut *const u8) -> u64 {$/

ctags.name: encode_varint
ctags.pattern: /^pub unsafe extern "C" fn encode_varint(value: u64, buf: *mut u8) -> u8 {$/
